title: Domain Event Structural Coupling
pattern: Publishing internal domain objects or database entity definitions directly as fields inside public, out-of-process Domain Events.
why_bad: It leaks representation details across contexts. Any change or refactoring to internal domain fields immediately breaks downstream event subscribers, ruining system evolvability.
detection: Domain event structures containing nested domain-layer entity types instead of flat primitive types.
counterexample: Internal, in-memory event structures that are never serialized or published across context boundaries.
fix:
Publish event DTOs containing only stable, flat primitive types or public interchange formats (Published Language).
```rust
struct UserRegisteredEvent {
    user_id: String,
    username: String,
    email: String,
}
```
source: *Implementing Domain-Driven Design* by Vaughn Vernon (Chapter 13, p. 547-548).
